definitions.gloss: magnanimity; tolerance; generosity of spirit; broad-mindedness
definitions.explanation: The capacity to accept and tolerate different people, opinions, and situations without becoming narrow-minded or petty. Often used to describe a leader or person of character.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{度量|どりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{度量|どりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Broad-mindedness is expected of a leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}せる→許す：02325_yurusu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度量|どりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついてこない。
examples.english: If you don't have the magnanimity to forgive your subordinates' mistakes, people won't follow you.

notes:
A literary and somewhat formal word describing the breadth of a person's character — their ability to accept others and handle situations with grace. Originally, {度量|どりょう} also meant "weights and measures" ({度量衡|どりょうこう}), but in modern usage the character-related meaning dominates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {度量|どりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: magnanimous, generous-spirited
- {度量|どりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧: broad-minded
- {度量|どりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧: narrow-minded, petty
- {度量|どりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person of great tolerance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{器|うつわ}が{大|おお}きい→器が大きい：25704_utsuwagaookii⟧: to be a big person (figuratively) — colloquial expression for the same quality
- ⟦{寛容|かんよう}→寛容：10888_kanyou⟧: tolerance, leniency — focuses more on the attitude of accepting differences
- ⟦{心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}い→心が広い：20972_kokorogahiroi⟧: open-hearted, generous — a more everyday expression for broad-mindedness
